data_confidence: ACTUAL/DERIVED — computed directly from order_date/edd/delivery_date/current_status/attempt_number, no fabricated values. 'Breach' includes late-delivered + RTO + Lost + still-open-past-EDD (broader than the edd_missed column used for the headline EDD adherence KPI, which only covers delivered-late shipments — see docs/data_assumptions.md).
